component.name: Windscribe
component.summary: VPN client with a desktop GUI

description.p: Windscribe is a VPN service client. It connects through WireGuard, OpenVPN or AmneziaWG, manages DNS and firewall rules while a tunnel is up, and lets you pick locations, set up split tunneling and keep the usual per-session options in one window.
The client talks to a privileged helper service, which performs the network configuration changes on its behalf.
